title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋~Rion–Antirion Bridge
focus: 在 65 m 深海、軟弱沉積層與活動斷層上，以可滑移基礎與連續全懸吊橋面化解地震與構造位移~Sliding foundations and a continuous fully suspended deck that absorb earthquakes and tectonic movement in 65 m of water on soft sediments
summary: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。~The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.

units.anchor: 墩間相對位移~Relative pier movement
units.title: 地震、斷層與海峽擴張的設計需求~Design demands from earthquakes, faults and a widening strait
units.mechanism: 橋址位於構造活躍的科林斯灣，營運單位公開的設計條件包括：地表尖峰加速度 0.48 g、0.2 至 1.0 s 週期的最大譜加速度 1.2 g、回歸期 2,000 年（120 年設計年限內 5% 超越機率），且相鄰橋墩之間須容許任何方向達 2 m 的斷層相對位移，塔的傾斜容許 1/500。這些需求使傳統「把結構牢牢固定」的做法行不通：基礎必須能在海床上滑移，橋面必須與塔分離懸吊，讓地震與構造位移由可控制的滑動、擺動與阻尼吸收，而不是由構件強度硬抗。最不利的設計組合是設計地震加上 50% 的構造位移。~The site lies in the tectonically active Gulf of Corinth. The operator’s published design criteria include a peak ground acceleration of 0.48 g, maximum spectral acceleration of 1.2 g for periods of 0.2 to 1.0 s, a 2,000-year return period (5% exceedance in the 120-year design life), up to 2 m of fault movement in any direction between adjacent piers and a pylon tilt allowance of 1/500. These demands rule out simply fixing the structure firmly: the foundations must be able to slide on the seabed and the deck must hang free of the pylons, so that seismic and tectonic movement is absorbed by controlled sliding, swinging and damping rather than resisted by member strength. The governing combination is the design earthquake plus 50% of the tectonic movements.
units.model: 若海峽以每年約 12.5 mm 擴張，120 年累積 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m；與 2 m 容許相對位移相比剩餘 0.5 m。若擴張速率取 15 mm/年，累積 1.8 m，餘裕只剩 0.2 m，說明構造位移與地震位移需一併規劃。擴張速率為教學假設，2 m 為公開設計值。~If the strait widens by about 12.5 mm a year, 120 years accumulate 12.5×120 = 1,500 mm = 1.5 m, leaving 0.5 m of the 2 m allowance. At 15 mm a year the total is 1.8 m with only 0.2 m to spare, showing that tectonic and seismic displacements must be planned together. The widening rate is a teaching assumption; 2 m is the published design value.
units.verify: 以場址特定地震危害分析建立設計譜與時間歷程，進行含基礎滑移與橋面擺動的非線性時間歷程分析；以岸邊與墩位的測地網定期量測實際構造位移，與設計假設的速率比較，必要時更新剩餘容量評估。~Build design spectra and time histories from a site-specific seismic hazard analysis and run nonlinear time-history analyses including foundation sliding and deck swinging; measure actual tectonic movement periodically with a geodetic network on the shores and at the piers, compare with the assumed rate and update the remaining-capacity assessment when needed.
units.failure: 若把基礎嵌固、橋面固定在塔上，地震力會直接灌入塔與基礎，構造位移則在固定點累積成巨大的強迫應力；相鄰墩的相對位移若超過伸縮縫與阻尼器行程，橋面可能撞擊或脫落。~Fixing the foundations and tying the deck to the pylons would drive seismic force straight into pylons and footings while tectonic movement accumulated as huge locked-in stresses; relative pier movement beyond joint and damper travel could make the deck collide or unseat.
units.misconception: 抗震設計的最佳做法永遠是把結構做得更強、更固定。~The best seismic design is always to make the structure stronger and more rigidly fixed.
units.practice: 設計基準文件要同時列出地震、構造位移、溫度與風的位移需求，並以「位移預算」逐項分配給基礎滑移、阻尼器行程、伸縮縫與支承；任何預算超支都需設計者書面確認。~The design basis should list displacement demands from earthquake, tectonic movement, temperature and wind together and allocate them in a displacement budget to foundation sliding, damper stroke, joints and bearings; any overrun requires the designer’s written confirmation.

units.title: 連續全懸吊橋面：熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器~Continuous suspended deck: fuse restrainers and viscous dampers
units.mechanism: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的橋面在全長 2,252 m 連續，並完全由斜索懸吊，不直接坐在塔上，地震時橋面像巨大的擺錘相對塔擺動。營運單位公開的配置是：主墩設 10.5 MN、過渡墩設 3.5 MN 的熔斷限制器，平時在強風下把橋面固定，地震時降伏斷開；同時並聯每支 3.5 MN 的黏滯阻尼器，塔位 4 支、過渡墩 2 支，主墩行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm，過渡墩 ±2,600 mm。熔斷限制器提供常時剛度，阻尼器在熔斷後限制擺幅並消耗能量，兩者分工讓風與地震的需求不必用同一個元件妥協。~The Rion–Antirion deck is continuous over its full 2,252 m and fully suspended by stays rather than resting on the pylons, so in an earthquake it swings like a giant pendulum relative to them. The operator’s published layout has fuse restrainers of 10.5 MN at the main piers and 3.5 MN at the transition piers that hold the deck in strong wind and yield in an earthquake, in parallel with viscous dampers of 3.5 MN each, 4 at the pylons and 2 at the transition piers, with strokes of −1,650 to +1,850 mm at main piers and ±2,600 mm at transition piers. The fuses provide everyday stiffness and the dampers limit swing and dissipate energy after the fuses break, so wind and seismic demands need not be compromised in one device.
units.model: 阻尼力 F = C·v^α，取 α = 0.15、在 v = 1.6 m/s 時 F = 3,500 kN：C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15；v = 0.1 m/s 時 F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN，速度降為 1/16 力只降約 34%。主墩熔斷力 10.5 MN 是單支阻尼器容量的 3 倍。α 與速度為教學假設。~Damper force F = C·v^α; with α = 0.15 and F = 3,500 kN at v = 1.6 m/s, C = 3,500/1.6^0.15 ≈ 3,262 kN/(m/s)^0.15, and at v = 0.1 m/s F ≈ 3,262×0.708 ≈ 2,309 kN: a sixteen-fold drop in speed lowers force by only about 34%. The 10.5 MN main-pier fuse is 3 times one damper’s capacity. α and velocities are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 熔斷元件以抽樣破壞試驗確認斷開力在設計範圍內，阻尼器做全尺寸力—速度與行程試驗；營運期以限制器上的荷重計長期記錄風力與溫度造成的力，確認遠低於熔斷值；地震後依荷重計資料判斷是否需要更換熔斷元件並重新校準。~Confirm fuse break force by sample destructive tests and test dampers full-size for force–velocity and stroke; in service record wind- and temperature-induced forces on the restrainer load cells to confirm they stay well below the fuse value, and after an earthquake use the load-cell data to decide whether fuses must be replaced and recalibrated.
units.failure: 熔斷值設得太低，強風或溫度力就會讓限制器斷開，橋面在日常風中擺動；設得太高，地震時不斷開，巨大的慣性力經限制器傳到塔與基礎。阻尼器行程不足則可能在大地震末段撞擊止擋。~A fuse set too low breaks in strong wind or under temperature force and lets the deck swing in everyday wind; set too high it does not break in an earthquake and sends huge inertia forces through to the pylons and foundations; insufficient damper stroke can hit the end stops late in a major quake.
units.misconception: 橋面懸吊在塔上自由擺動，地震時就不需要任何阻尼裝置。~If the deck hangs freely from the pylons, it needs no damping devices in an earthquake.
units.practice: 熔斷元件應設計為地震後可快速更換的消耗件，並在現場或倉庫保留備品；監測系統要把限制器荷重與阻尼器行程列為事件後自動報告的必要內容。~Design fuses as sacrificial parts that can be replaced quickly after an earthquake, keep spares on site or in store, and make restrainer loads and damper strokes mandatory content of automatic post-event reports.

units.title: 加勁土壤與可滑移基礎~Reinforced soil and sliding foundations
units.mechanism: 海床沉積層厚度超過 500 m，以黏土為主夾砂與粉土，調查至海床下 100 m 仍未見岩盤，打樁到岩盤不可行。營運單位公開資料指出，設計在每座墩下打入約 150 至 200 根直徑 2 m、長 25 至 30 m、間距 7 m 的中空鋼管，改良上部 20 m 土層，再鋪 3 m 厚礫石層，基礎直接坐在礫石上而不與鋼管連接。鋼管提高土壤的剪力強度與承載，避免基礎傾覆或大量沉陷；礫石層則讓基礎在強震時可以水平滑移，限制傳入上部結構的力量，這是「容量設計」觀念在基礎上的應用。~The seabed sediments are over 500 m thick, mainly clay with sand and silt, and no rock was found within 100 m below the seabed, so piling to rock was not possible. Operator data state that about 150 to 200 hollow steel pipes, 2 m in diameter, 25 to 30 m long and 7 m apart, were driven under each pier to improve the top 20 m of soil, then a 3 m gravel layer was placed and the footing rests on the gravel without connection to the pipes. The inclusions raise the soil’s shear strength and bearing to prevent overturning or large settlement, while the gravel lets the footing slide horizontally in a strong earthquake, capping the force transmitted to the superstructure: capacity design applied to a foundation.
units.model: 面積置換率 a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%。基礎滑移前可傳遞的最大水平力 H = N·tanφ：取有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN、礫石摩擦角 φ = 35°（tanφ ≈ 0.700），H ≈ 420,000 kN；超過此值基礎滑移，上部力量不再增加。N 與 φ 為教學假設。~Area replacement ratio a_s = π·r²/s² = π×1²/7² ≈ 6.4%. The largest horizontal force before the footing slides is H = N·tanφ; with an effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN and gravel friction angle φ = 35° (tanφ ≈ 0.700), H ≈ 420,000 kN, beyond which the footing slides and the force on the superstructure stops rising. N and φ are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以離心機模型或數值分析驗證加勁土壤在反覆荷載下的承載與滑移行為；施工時逐根記錄插入物的貫入深度與位置，礫石層以水下測深確認厚度與平整度；營運期以測地與沉陷量測確認基礎沉陷落在預期的 0.1 至 0.2 m 範圍。~Verify the bearing and sliding behaviour of the reinforced soil under cyclic loading with centrifuge models or numerical analysis; record each inclusion’s penetration and position during construction and confirm gravel thickness and flatness by underwater survey; in service confirm footing settlement stays within the expected 0.1 to 0.2 m by geodetic and settlement measurements.
units.failure: 若把插入物當成樁並與基礎剛接，地震時樁頭承受巨大剪力與彎矩，可能破壞；礫石層摩擦過高則基礎不滑移，上部結構承受遠超預期的地震力；插入物不足則基礎可能傾覆或產生不均勻沉陷。~Treating the inclusions as piles rigidly tied to the footing would load their heads with huge shear and moment in an earthquake; gravel friction that is too high prevents sliding and exposes the superstructure to far larger forces; too few inclusions risk overturning or differential settlement.
units.misconception: 軟弱海床上的大橋基礎一定要用長樁打到岩盤。~Bridge foundations on soft seabed must always use long piles driven to rock.
units.practice: 基礎設計報告要清楚區分「加勁土壤」與「樁基礎」的力學假設，並在圖上註明礫石層與基礎之間不得有任何連接；水下施工記錄（插入物位置、礫石厚度）要完整交接給營運單位。~The foundation report must clearly separate the mechanics of reinforced soil from piled foundations and the drawings must state that nothing connects the footing to the gravel; underwater construction records of inclusion positions and gravel thickness must be handed over completely to the operator.

units.anchor: 90 m 直徑基礎~90 m diameter footings
units.title: 90 m 沉箱的乾塢製作與浮運~Dry-dock casting and floating of the 90 m caissons
units.mechanism: 每座塔基礎直徑 90 m，上接由 38 m 漸縮到 26 m 的錐形墩身，再接邊長 38 m、由四支 4 m × 4 m 混凝土腿組成的塔座。營運單位公開資料指出，基礎底部在長 200 m、寬 100 m、深 14 m 的乾塢中製作，可同時做兩座；底部澆到約 15 m 高、具備足夠浮力後灌水浮出，拖到濕塢繼續在浮動狀態下接高錐形段，最後拖到墩位以壓艙水下沉就位。這個方法把大量混凝土作業移到岸邊受控環境，但浮運期間的吃水、穩定性與拖航條件都必須精確計算。~Each pylon footing is 90 m in diameter, topped by a conical shaft tapering from 38 m to 26 m and a 38 m square pylon base with four 4 m × 4 m concrete legs. Operator data state that the footing bases were cast in a dry dock 200 m long, 100 m wide and 14 m deep, two at a time; once about 15 m high and buoyant, they were floated out, towed to a wet dock where the conical part was built while floating, then towed to position and sunk with ballast water. The method moves most concrete work to a controlled shore site, but draft, stability and towing conditions while afloat must be calculated precisely.
units.model: 吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A)。底面積 A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m²，每公尺吃水排水約 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t；若浮出時結構重 60,000 t，d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m，低於乾塢 14 m 深度，留有約 4.8 m 餘裕。重量為教學假設，尺寸為公開資料。~Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A). The base area A = π×45² ≈ 6,362 m² displaces about 6,362×1.025 ≈ 6,521 t per metre of draft; a 60,000 t structure at float-out draws d ≈ 60,000/6,521 ≈ 9.2 m, below the 14 m dock depth with about 4.8 m to spare. The weight is a teaching assumption; dimensions are published values.
units.verify: 每次澆置後以實際混凝土量與密度更新重量與重心，計算吃水、穩心高度與拖航時的傾斜；浮出與下沉作業前確認潮位、波浪與拖船配置，下沉過程以壓艙水量與四周吃水尺同步監控，確保均勻下沉。~After each pour update weight and centre of gravity from actual quantities and density and compute draft, metacentric height and heel under tow; before float-out and sinking confirm tide, waves and tug arrangement, and during sinking monitor ballast volumes and draft marks around the perimeter to keep the descent level.
units.failure: 重量或重心估算錯誤，可能使結構在乾塢內擱淺無法浮出，或在拖航中傾斜過大；下沉時壓艙不均造成傾斜就位，會讓基礎在礫石層上偏心受力，並使塔的初始傾斜超出 1/500 的容許值。~Wrong weight or centre-of-gravity estimates can leave the structure grounded in the dock or heeling excessively under tow; uneven ballasting during sinking lands it tilted, loading the gravel eccentrically and pushing the pylon’s initial tilt beyond the 1/500 allowance.
units.misconception: 混凝土結構太重，不可能在海上浮運。~Concrete structures are too heavy to float and tow at sea.
units.practice: 浮運與下沉計畫要由海事工程師與結構設計者共同簽認，列出每個階段的重量、吃水、穩定性、氣象門檻與中止條件；乾塢閘門與排水系統的檢查要列為浮出前的停留檢查點。~Float-out and sinking plans need joint sign-off by the marine engineer and the structural designer, listing weight, draft, stability, weather limits and abort criteria for each stage; inspection of the dock gate and dewatering systems is a hold point before float-out.

units.title: 65 m 水深的海床整備與礫石鋪設公差~Seabed preparation at 65 m depth and gravel-bed tolerances
units.mechanism: 在水深達 65 m 的海峽中，浚挖海床、打入數百根鋼管插入物並鋪設 3 m 礫石層，都必須在穩定的平台上進行。營運單位公開資料指出，承包團隊為此打造專用的張力腿駁船：以錨鏈或錨索拉緊固定在海床上的重物，使駁船在波浪中幾乎不上下起伏，成為深水中的穩定工作平台。礫石層的平整度直接決定沉箱坐落後的傾斜，而塔的傾斜容許只有 1/500，所以水下鋪設的公差比一般海事工程嚴格得多，需要以精密測深與耙平工具反覆修整。~In a strait up to 65 m deep, dredging the seabed, driving hundreds of steel inclusions and placing a 3 m gravel layer all need a stable platform. Operator data state that the team built a purpose-made tension-leg barge, held down by taut lines to anchors on the seabed so it barely heaves in waves, giving a stable work platform in deep water. The flatness of the gravel bed determines the tilt of the caisson once landed, and the pylon tilt allowance is only 1/500, so underwater placement tolerances are much tighter than in ordinary marine work and need repeated precise soundings and screeding.
units.model: 基礎直徑 90 m，若礫石面兩端高差 Δ，傾斜 = Δ/90。容許 1/500 時 Δ = 90/500 = 0.18 m；若只允許用掉一半預算給礫石面，Δ 須小於約 0.09 m。高差 0.10 m 對應傾斜 0.10/90 ≈ 1/900。預算分配為教學假設，1/500 為公開設計值。~For a 90 m footing, a level difference Δ across the gravel gives a tilt of Δ/90. The 1/500 allowance corresponds to Δ = 90/500 = 0.18 m; if only half that budget may be spent on the gravel bed, Δ must stay below about 0.09 m. A 0.10 m difference corresponds to 0.10/90 ≈ 1/900. The budget split is a teaching assumption; 1/500 is the published design value.
units.verify: 鋪設前後以多音束或高精度單音束測深建立礫石面的數值地形，網格點高差與整體平面度逐項比對公差；必要時以水下攝影或潛水員確認局部異常，沉箱就位後量測塔座傾斜，回算實際礫石面效果。~Before and after placement build a digital terrain of the gravel surface by multibeam or high-precision single-beam sounding, checking grid-point differences and overall flatness against tolerance; confirm local anomalies by underwater video or divers, and after landing measure the pylon base tilt to back-calculate the gravel-bed outcome.
units.failure: 礫石面不平或局部鬆散，沉箱坐落後產生初始傾斜與不均勻接觸，地震時滑移行為也偏離設計；張力腿系統若失效，駁船起伏使插入物定位與打設深度出現誤差。~An uneven or locally loose gravel surface gives the landed caisson an initial tilt and uneven contact, and makes its seismic sliding behaviour depart from design; if the tension-leg system fails, barge heave introduces errors in inclusion position and driving depth.
units.misconception: 深海的礫石墊層只是填料，平整度要求可以放寬。~A deep-water gravel bed is just fill, so its flatness can be relaxed.
units.practice: 水下作業的檢查計畫要訂出測深頻率、網格大小、容許高差與重整條件，並把礫石面驗收列為沉箱下沉前的停留檢查點，由業主代表與設計者共同簽認。~The underwater inspection plan should set sounding frequency, grid size, allowable differences and rework triggers, with gravel-bed acceptance a hold point before caisson sinking, signed jointly by the owner’s representative and the designer.

units.anchor: 12 m 預製節段~12 m precast segments
units.title: 組合橋面的平衡懸臂架設~Balanced-cantilever erection of the composite deck
units.mechanism: 里翁—安提里翁大橋的組合橋面寬 27.2 m，每側兩根 2.2 m 高的鋼板梁，每 4 m 一道橫梁，上覆混凝土橋面板。營運單位公開資料指出，橋面以 12 m 長、約 340 t 的預製節段由浮吊放置，從每座塔向兩側平衡懸臂推進，最快每週約 60 m。平衡懸臂的關鍵在於兩側重量與斜索力保持對稱：只要一側先放節段，塔就要承受一個節段重量乘上懸臂長度的不平衡彎矩，懸臂愈長愈大。因此架設順序、臨時配重與斜索張拉步驟都必須事先排定。~The Rion–Antirion composite deck is 27.2 m wide, with two 2.2 m deep steel plate girders on each side, cross girders every 4 m and a concrete deck slab. Operator data state that it was erected in 12 m precast segments of about 340 t placed by floating crane, advancing as balanced cantilevers from each pylon at up to about 60 m a week. The key is keeping weights and stay forces symmetrical on both sides: whenever one side receives a segment first, the pylon carries an unbalanced moment equal to a segment’s weight times the cantilever length, growing as the cantilever lengthens. Erection order, temporary counterweights and stay-stressing steps must therefore be planned in advance.
units.model: 一個 340 t 節段約 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN，若在懸臂長 280 m 處先單側放置，不平衡彎矩 M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m；每週 60 m 相當於 60/12 = 5 個節段。若兩側交替並以臨時配重平衡，可把 M 控制在一半以下。懸臂長度為教學假設。~One 340 t segment weighs about 340×9.81 ≈ 3,335 kN; placed on one side at a 280 m cantilever, it creates an unbalanced moment M = 3,335×280 ≈ 933,900 kN·m. Sixty metres a week is 60/12 = 5 segments. Alternating sides with temporary counterweights can keep M below half that. The cantilever length is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 每個節段就位後量測兩側懸臂端高程、塔頂偏位與新裝斜索的索力，與施工控制模型比較；超出容許時先調整斜索力再進行下一節段；浮吊作業前確認風浪條件與吊重紀錄。~After each segment is placed, survey both cantilever-tip levels, pylon-top displacement and the new stay’s force and compare with the construction-control model; if outside tolerance, adjust stay forces before the next segment; confirm wind and wave conditions and lift records before each floating-crane operation.
units.failure: 不平衡架設超過塔的設計容量，會使塔頂偏位過大、塔身開裂；若相鄰兩個懸臂在合龍時高差過大，需強制頂壓才能對接，會在橋面留下殘餘應力。~Unbalanced erection beyond the pylon’s capacity causes excessive pylon sway and cracking; a large level difference between adjacent cantilevers at closure forces jacking to align them, leaving residual stress in the deck.
units.misconception: 平衡懸臂只要最後兩側長度相同，中間的施工順序不重要。~In balanced cantilever erection only the final equal lengths matter, not the order in between.
units.practice: 架設計畫要列出每一步的容許不平衡彎矩、臨時配重位置與量測項目，並規定強風或浮吊故障時的懸臂臨時固定方式；每座塔的合龍視為停留檢查點。~The erection plan should list the allowable unbalanced moment, temporary counterweight positions and measurements for every step and define how cantilevers are secured in strong wind or if the floating crane fails; each closure is a hold point.

units.anchor: 限制器荷重計~Restrainer load cells
units.title: WEASHM 監測系統與事件自動報告~The WEASHM monitoring system and automatic event reports
units.mechanism: 營運單位公開資料指出，大橋的監測系統（WEASHM）有超過 100 個感測器、約 300 個通道，分布於塔、橋面、斜索與伸縮縫，以 100 Hz 取樣，量測荷重、斜索振動、橋面與塔振動、伸縮縫位移，以及風速風向與氣溫、橋面溫度。資料在四座塔內先以硬體處理並與門檻比較，再經光纖送到營運大樓與控制室；地震或強風等特殊事件開始 5 分鐘後會自動寄出報告。限制器上的荷重計特別重要，因為它直接告訴營運者熔斷元件是否接近或已經斷開，以及地震後是否需要重新校準。~Operator data state that the bridge’s monitoring system (WEASHM) has more than 100 sensors and about 300 channels on pylons, deck, stays and expansion joints, sampling at 100 Hz to measure loads, stay vibration, deck and pylon vibration and joint displacement, as well as wind speed and direction, air and deck temperature. Data are processed in hardware inside the four pylons and compared with thresholds, then sent by optical fibre to the operations building and control room; an automatic report is emailed 5 minutes after a special event such as an earthquake or high wind begins. The load cells on the restrainers are especially important, telling the operator whether the fuses are near breaking or have broken and whether recalibration is needed after an earthquake.
units.model: 資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 位元組 × 秒數 = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes，約 10.4 GB/日；100 Hz 取樣的可用頻寬上限（奈奎斯特頻率）為 50 Hz，足以涵蓋斜索與橋面的主要模態。每點 4 bytes 為教學假設。~Data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes × seconds = 300×100×4×86,400 ≈ 1.04×10¹⁰ bytes, about 10.4 GB per day; 100 Hz sampling gives a usable bandwidth up to the 50 Hz Nyquist frequency, enough for the main stay and deck modes. Four bytes per sample is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 定期以人工量測（例如振動法索力、手持加速度計）比對感測器讀值，檢查漂移與時間同步；以已知事件（強風日、重車通過）驗證門檻與自動報告流程是否正確觸發，並保存原始資料與處理參數。~Periodically compare sensor readings with manual measurements such as vibration-based stay force or handheld accelerometers, checking drift and time synchronisation; use known events such as high-wind days or heavy vehicles to confirm thresholds and automatic reporting trigger correctly, and archive raw data with processing parameters.
units.failure: 門檻設定只依設計值而未考慮正常季節變化，會產生大量誤報，使營運人員忽略警報；感測器失效或時間不同步若未被發現，地震後的報告可能遺漏關鍵資訊，延誤檢查與交通管制決策。~Thresholds set from design values without normal seasonal variation generate floods of false alarms that operators learn to ignore; undetected sensor failure or loss of synchronisation can leave key information out of a post-earthquake report, delaying inspection and traffic decisions.
units.misconception: 感測器越多、取樣越快，監測系統就一定越有用。~More sensors and faster sampling always make a monitoring system more useful.
units.practice: 監測系統交接要包含感測器清單、校正紀錄、門檻邏輯、自動報告格式與事件後的檢查流程，並明訂誰在收到報告後多少時間內決定封橋或放行。~Monitoring handover should include the sensor list, calibration records, threshold logic, report format and post-event inspection procedure, and state who decides closure or reopening and within what time after a report arrives.

units.anchor: 岸邊與墩位測地點~Shore and pier geodetic points
units.title: 測地監測、塔傾斜與構造位移追蹤~Geodetic monitoring, pylon tilt and tectonic tracking
units.mechanism: 感測器擅長記錄動態反應，但緩慢的構造位移、基礎沉陷與塔的傾斜需要另一種工具。營運單位公開資料指出，大橋定期以傳統測地方法（非永久系統）量測橋梁幾何以及兩岸與各墩位的構造位移。這些量測把每座塔、每個基礎放進同一個座標系統，追蹤多年下來的相對位移、沉陷與傾斜是否仍在設計預算內。塔高很大，即使很小的傾斜也會在塔頂放大成明顯位移，進而改變斜索幾何與索力，因此傾斜量測同時是結構與斜索系統的健康指標。~Sensors excel at dynamic response, but slow tectonic movement, foundation settlement and pylon tilt need another tool. Operator data state that bridge geometry and tectonic movements at the shores and pier locations are measured at regular intervals by classical geodetic survey rather than a permanent system. These surveys place every pylon and footing in one coordinate system and track whether relative displacement, settlement and tilt over the years remain within the design budget. Because the pylons are tall, even a small tilt is magnified into a visible top displacement that changes stay geometry and forces, so tilt is a health indicator for both the structure and its stay system.
units.model: 塔頂偏位 = 傾斜 × 高度。若塔座以上高度取 160 m，容許傾斜 1/500 對應 160/500 = 0.32 m；若量測到傾斜 1/2,000，塔頂偏位只有約 0.08 m，仍在預算的四分之一。高度為教學假設，1/500 為公開設計值。~Pylon-top offset = tilt × height. Taking 160 m above the pylon base, the 1/500 allowance corresponds to 160/500 = 0.32 m; a measured tilt of 1/2,000 gives only about 0.08 m, a quarter of the budget. The height is a teaching assumption; 1/500 is the published design value.
units.verify: 以岸上穩定基準點建立控制網，定期以 GNSS 與精密水準量測各墩基礎與塔頂標誌，所有量測修正到同一溫度與時刻；結果與前次及設計預測比較，若相對位移或傾斜速率改變，加密量測頻率並檢討伸縮縫與阻尼器剩餘行程。~Establish a control network from stable shore benchmarks and survey pier footings and pylon-top targets periodically by GNSS and precise levelling, correcting all readings to a common temperature and time; compare with previous surveys and design predictions, and if relative displacement or tilt rates change, survey more often and review remaining joint and damper travel.
units.failure: 若量測沒有修正日照溫度，塔頂的熱偏位會被誤判為基礎傾斜；若量測間隔太長，地震後的永久位移可能未被及時發現，伸縮縫與阻尼器在下一次事件中已無足夠行程。~Without solar temperature correction, thermal sway at the pylon top can be mistaken for footing tilt; with too long an interval, permanent displacement after an earthquake may go unnoticed and joints and dampers may lack travel for the next event.
units.misconception: 有了即時感測器，就不需要定期做傳統測量。~With real-time sensors there is no need for periodic conventional surveys.
units.practice: 測量計畫應規定基準點的保護與複核、量測時段（清晨溫度均勻時）、精度要求與成果格式；地震後必做一次全橋測地量測並與上次結果比較，作為開放交通決策的依據之一。~The survey plan should protect and recheck benchmarks, fix measurement times at dawn when temperature is uniform, and define accuracy and reporting format; after any earthquake a full geodetic survey compared with the previous one is mandatory input to the reopening decision.

units.anchor: M1 塔斜索~Stays at pylon M1
units.title: 雷擊、斜索火災與單索更換~Lightning, stay fire and single-stay replacement
units.mechanism: 2005 年 1 月 28 日，通車約半年後，大橋 M1 塔頂附近一根斜索因雷擊引起火災而斷落橋面，交通隨即中斷，修復後重新開放。斜索系統供應商公開資料指出，其後在更換受損斜索的同時，為斜索加裝了雷擊防護。斜索斷失是斜張橋必須設計的意外工況：斷索瞬間釋放的能量使相鄰斜索與橋面產生動力放大，力量重新分配到鄰索；設計必須確認鄰索與橋面在這個工況下不會連鎖破壞，同時要有可以在交通管制下更換單索的程序。~On 28 January 2005, about six months after opening, a stay near the top of pylon M1 failed after a lightning strike started a fire, and fell onto the deck; traffic was stopped and the bridge reopened after repair. The stay supplier’s public material states that lightning protection was installed while the damaged stay was replaced. Stay loss is an accidental case every cable-stayed bridge must be designed for: the sudden release of energy dynamically amplifies the response of neighbouring stays and the deck as force redistributes; design must confirm that neighbours and deck do not fail progressively and that a single stay can be replaced under traffic management.
units.model: 61 股鋼絞線斜索破斷力 = 61×150 mm²×1,770 MPa ≈ 16,200 kN。若失去一根 5,000 kN 的斜索，取動力放大係數 2.0、相鄰索分擔 35%，鄰索增量 = 0.35×2.0×5,000 = 3,500 kN，總力 8,500 kN，約為破斷力的 52%。股數、索力與分擔比為教學假設。~A 61-strand stay has a breaking force of 61×150 mm²×1,770 MPa ≈ 16,200 kN. If a 5,000 kN neighbour is lost, with a dynamic amplification factor of 2.0 and 35% picked up by the adjacent stay, the increment is 0.35×2.0×5,000 = 3,500 kN for a total of 8,500 kN, about 52% of breaking force. Strand count, force and share are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性動力分析模擬各代表性斜索的突然斷失，檢查鄰索應力比、橋面彎矩與塔的反應；雷擊防護系統依相關防雷標準驗證接地與導通，更換斜索時以荷重計與測量監控臨時索力與橋面線形。~Simulate sudden loss of representative stays with nonlinear dynamic analysis, checking neighbour stress ratios, deck moments and pylon response; verify lightning protection grounding and continuity under the relevant lightning standard, and monitor temporary forces and deck profile with load cells and survey during stay replacement.
units.failure: 未設計斷索工況時，一根斜索失效可能使鄰索超載連鎖斷裂；HDPE 套管可燃，若未考慮雷擊或車輛火災，火勢可能沿套管蔓延，使鋼絞線高溫失去強度。~Without a stay-loss case, one failure can overload neighbours in a chain; HDPE ducts are combustible, and without consideration of lightning or vehicle fire, flames can spread along the duct and heat the strands until they lose strength.
units.misconception: 斜索是由許多鋼絞線組成的，所以整根斜索不可能突然失效。~Because a stay is made of many strands, the whole stay can never fail suddenly.
units.practice: 每座斜張橋都應有書面的斷索應變計畫：交通管制、臨時支撐、備品來源與更換程序；防雷與防火措施要列入斜索系統規格，並在檢查中確認接地完整。~Every cable-stayed bridge should have a written stay-loss contingency plan covering traffic control, temporary support, spare supply and replacement procedure; lightning and fire protection belong in the stay-system specification, with earthing checked during inspections.

units.title: 海洋混凝土耐久與 120 年檢查維護~Marine concrete durability and 120-year inspection
units.mechanism: 大橋設計使用年限 120 年，營運單位公開的檢查與維護手冊經獨立工程師核可，將混凝土耐久列為主要風險之一：海水化學侵蝕、氯離子引致的鋼筋腐蝕與二氧化碳造成的中性化腐蝕。防護依暴露分區規定保護層厚度與混凝土性質；營運期以平板電腦搭配客製軟體做目視檢查，缺陷分類後標在電子圖上，並以定期試驗量測氯離子滲透與擴散係數以推估剩餘壽命。檢查方式涵蓋橋面檢修車、墩座吊籃、繩索技術檢查塔與斜索，以及以水下遙控載具或潛水員檢查墩座與沖刷防護。~The bridge has a 120-year design life, and the operator’s inspection and maintenance manual, approved by the independent engineer, lists concrete durability as a main risk: chemical attack by seawater, chloride-induced reinforcement corrosion and carbonation-induced corrosion. Protection relies on cover and concrete properties defined by exposure zone; in service, visual inspections use tablet PCs with customised software, classify defects and mark them on electronic drawings, and regular tests measure chloride penetration and diffusivity to estimate remaining life. Access includes the deck gantry, pier-base cradles, rope access for pylons and stays, and ROVs or divers for pier bases and scour protection.
units.model: Fick 第二定律 C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]。取 C_s = 0.6%（膠結料重）、D = 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s、t = 50 年、x = 60 mm：2√(Dt) ≈ 0.056 m，erf(1.068) ≈ 0.869，C ≈ 0.6×0.131 ≈ 0.079%，低於約 0.4% 的腐蝕起始門檻；若 D = 2×10⁻¹² m²/s，C ≈ 0.27%。數值為教學假設。~Fick’s second law C(x,t) = C_s·[1 − erf(x/(2√(D·t)))]. With C_s = 0.6% by binder mass, D = 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s, t = 50 years and x = 60 mm, 2√(Dt) ≈ 0.056 m, erf(1.068) ≈ 0.869 and C ≈ 0.6×0.131 ≈ 0.079%, below a corrosion threshold of about 0.4%; with D = 2×10⁻¹² m²/s, C ≈ 0.27%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在各暴露分區設固定取樣點，定期鑽取粉末量測不同深度的氯離子濃度，擬合表面濃度與擴散係數，並與上一輪結果比較；同時以保護層量測與半電池電位檢查高風險區，所有結果進入單一資料庫並自動產生報告。~Fix sampling points in each exposure zone, periodically drill dust at several depths for chloride concentration, fit surface concentration and diffusivity and compare with the previous round; check high-risk areas with cover surveys and half-cell potential, entering all results into a single database with automatic reporting.
units.failure: 若只做目視檢查而沒有氯離子剖面，腐蝕起始前的劣化趨勢無法察覺，等到鏽水與剝落出現時修復範圍已大；水下墩座與沖刷防護若缺乏定期檢查，局部損壞可能長期未被發現。~Visual inspection without chloride profiles misses the trend before corrosion starts, so by the time rust staining and spalling appear the repair area is large; without regular underwater inspection, local damage to pier bases and scour protection can go unnoticed for years.
units.misconception: 高強度海工混凝土在 120 年內不需要任何耐久性檢測。~High-strength marine concrete needs no durability testing over 120 years.
units.practice: 檢查與維護手冊要明訂各構件的檢查週期、取樣位置、允收門檻與觸發維修的條件，並把檢查結果由結構維護工程師、原設計者與專業供應商共同評估後決定行動。~The inspection and maintenance manual should set inspection intervals, sampling positions, acceptance thresholds and repair triggers for each component, with findings assessed jointly by the structural maintenance engineers, the original designer and specialist suppliers before action is decided.

example: 設計練習：比較一座 90 m 基礎在地震中「不滑移」與「可滑移」時傳到上部結構的水平力。設基礎與塔座、墩身的有效質量 M = 80,000 t，若完全固定，以譜加速度 1.2 g 估算慣性力 F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN。若基礎坐在礫石層上、摩擦係數 μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70、有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN（扣除浮力），滑移前最大水平力 H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN，只有固定時的 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45%。代價是滑移位移：若地震造成 0.5 m 永久滑移，需確認伸縮縫與阻尼器的位移預算仍足夠（主墩阻尼器行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm）。若礫石摩擦角改為 30°（tan30° ≈ 0.577），H ≈ 346,400 kN，力量更低但滑移量會增加。質量、垂直力與摩擦角為教學假設，非本橋設計值。~Design exercise: compare the horizontal force passed to the superstructure by a 90 m footing that cannot slide with one that can. Take an effective mass of footing, base and shaft M = 80,000 t; if fully fixed, a spectral acceleration of 1.2 g gives an inertia force F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN. If the footing rests on gravel with friction coefficient μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70 and effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN after buoyancy, the largest horizontal force before sliding is H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN, only 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45% of the fixed case. The price is sliding displacement: if the earthquake leaves 0.5 m of permanent slip, the displacement budget of joints and dampers must still suffice (main-pier damper stroke −1,650 to +1,850 mm). With a 30° gravel friction angle (tan30° ≈ 0.577), H ≈ 346,400 kN, a lower force but more sliding. Mass, vertical force and friction angle are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.
history: 連接伯羅奔尼撒半島與希臘大陸的里翁—安提里翁大橋由 Vinci 主導的法希聯營以特許經營方式設計、興建與營運，1998 年展開海床整備與浚挖，2000 年起建塔，2004 年 5 月完工、8 月通車。面對 65 m 水深、超過 500 m 厚的軟弱沉積層、強震與海峽持續擴張，設計團隊採用加勁土壤上可滑移的大直徑基礎與連續全懸吊橋面，成為當時連續懸吊長度最長的多跨斜張橋。2005 年 1 月一根斜索遭雷擊起火斷落，修復時加裝了防雷系統。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。~The Rion–Antirion Bridge, linking the Peloponnese with mainland Greece, was designed, built and operated under a concession by a French–Greek consortium led by Vinci; seabed preparation and dredging began in 1998, pylon construction started in 2000, and the bridge was completed in May 2004 and opened in August. Facing 65 m of water, soft sediments over 500 m thick, strong earthquakes and a widening strait, the team chose large sliding footings on reinforced soil and a continuous fully suspended deck, creating the longest continuous suspended multi-span cable-stayed deck of its time. In January 2005 a stay failed after a lightning strike started a fire, and lightning protection was added during the repair. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.
facts: 斜張橋段 286+3×560+286 = 2,252 m，橋面連續且全懸吊~The cable-stayed section is 286+3×560+286 = 2,252 m with a continuous fully suspended deck
四座塔基礎直徑 90 m，坐於 3 m 厚礫石層~The four pylon footings are 90 m in diameter and rest on a 3 m gravel layer
水深達 65 m，沉積層厚度超過 500 m~Water depth reaches 65 m, with sediments over 500 m thick
加勁鋼管直徑 2 m、長 25 至 30 m、間距 7 m~Reinforcing steel pipes are 2 m in diameter, 25 to 30 m long and 7 m apart
設計地表加速度 0.48 g，回歸期 2,000 年，相鄰墩可相對位移 2 m~Design PGA is 0.48 g with a 2,000-year return period and 2 m relative movement between piers
主墩熔斷限制器 10.5 MN，黏滯阻尼器每支 3.5 MN~Main-pier fuse restrainers are 10.5 MN and viscous dampers 3.5 MN each
組合橋面寬 27.2 m，以 12 m、約 340 t 節段每週最快約 60 m 架設~The 27.2 m composite deck was erected in 12 m segments of about 340 t at up to about 60 m a week
每根斜索 43 至 73 股鍍鋅鋼絞線~Each stay has 43 to 73 galvanised strands
船撞設計為 180,000 載重噸油輪以 16 節航速撞擊~Ship impact design covers a 180,000 dwt tanker at 16 knots
監測系統超過 100 個感測器、約 300 通道、100 Hz 取樣~The monitoring system has over 100 sensors, about 300 channels and 100 Hz sampling

timeline.event: 7 月展開海床整備與浚挖，乾塢開始製作基礎~Seabed preparation and dredging begin in July, with footings cast in the dry dock
四座塔在浮運就位的基礎上施築完成~The four pylons are built on the floated-in footings
5 月完工，8 月通車，成為連續懸吊長度最長的多跨斜張橋~Completed in May and opened in August as the longest continuous suspended multi-span cable-stayed deck
1 月 28 日 M1 塔一根斜索遭雷擊起火斷落，修復時加裝防雷系統~On 28 January a stay at pylon M1 fails after a lightning fire; lightning protection is added during repair

codes: EN 1998-2 歐洲規範 8 第 2 部：橋梁耐震設計~EN 1998-2 Eurocode 8 Part 2: Seismic design of bridges
EN 1998-5 歐洲規範 8 第 5 部：基礎、擋土結構與大地工程~EN 1998-5 Eurocode 8 Part 5: Foundations, retaining structures and geotechnical aspects
fib Bulletin 30 預力鋼斜拉索系統驗收建議~fib Bulletin 30 Acceptance of stay cable systems using prestressing steels
